previous_format: Flat 4B (animal flatmates sitcom) - scripts archived in channels/flat4b/archive/
format: Cinematic, narrated, true survival story of one creature (or cell). 7 shots = 64 s: shock hook (stat + action) -> escalating threats -> explainer mid-chase -> heartbreak -> triumph -> loop/twist back to the start. One consistent narrator voice, no character dialogue.
style_prompt: cinematic hyper-detailed 3D animation in the style of a premium nature documentary, photoreal textures, dramatic natural lighting, volumetric light rays, shallow depth of field, epic scale, emotional, vertical 9:16 composition with the subject centred, no text, no logos, no humans unless described
audio_prompt: natural cinematic sound effects and ambience only, no voices, no narration, no music (music and narrator are added in post)
negative_prompt: text, logos, cartoon faces on animals, talking animals, gore, blood, real identifiable people

narrator.style: warm, deep, British documentary narrator, calm but gripping

content_rules: Every fact must be mainstream biology. Hedge numbers ('about', 'up to', 'some').
Narration <= 2.4 words per second of shot. Shot 1 (6 s) is the hook: a stat or shocking fact + action, <= 14 words.
No fake rescues, no anthropomorphic talking animals, no gore (danger is implied, deaths happen off-screen).
The last line loops back to the first image or the next generation.
Episode creatures/places live in the episode's 'guests' and 'locations' (ids prefixed oitNNN_).
ai_disclosure: Animated with AI. Facts reviewed against mainstream science sources; the story is a dramatised illustration.
